question: The denaturing of proteins:

options.opa: Alters the native conformation without affecting the biological activity.
options.opc: It can only be achieved by treatment with strong acids.
options.opd: It does not affect the primary structure.
options.ope: It produces the hydrolysis of the protein.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Denaturing of proteins -> Alters the native conformation without affecting the biological activity -> 80% CHAIN: Denaturing of proteins -> It is not always irreversible -> 70% CHAIN: Denaturing of proteins -> Can be achieved by treatment with strong acids in some cases -> 60% CHAIN: Denaturing of proteins -> Does not affect the primary structure -> 90% CHAIN: Denaturing of proteins -> Does not necessarily produce the hydrolysis of the protein -> 80%
